test_debug_visualizer: test the DebugVisualizer class for scene peeking, agent creation, and equirectangular mode switching
create_debug_visualizer_agent: create a DebugVisualizer agent with a Habitat simulator to register sensors and agents
peek_scene: peek at the current scene using DebugVisualizer to capture debug visualization observations

get_observation: get a debug observation image from DebugVisualizer given a color vector and position
